name: floorplan-to-3d
description: Turn a floor-plan image with written dimensions into a verified 2D overlay (stops for approval), then an interactive three.js 3D model with openings, furniture, walk view and a measuring tool.

interface.shortDescription: Verify a floor plan's dimensions, then get an interactive 3D model
interface.longDescription: Give it a floor-plan image with written dimensions. Stage 1 builds a 2D verification drawing on top of the original (black = written dimension, orange = estimated from scale, red = uncertain or failed check) with open questions, and stops for your approval. Stage 2 builds an interactive three.js model from exactly the approved data: walls with real door and window openings, furniture, orbit / top / walk views and a click-to-measure tool.
